newsitem.title: USA: ESC Medical gets FDA warning letter.
newsitem.headline: ESC Medical gets FDA warning letter.

text.p: ESC Medical Systems Inc said Tuesday it has received a warning letter from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration regarding the promotion of its Derma 20 laser system.
ESC Medical said it modified its promotional material in response to the FDA warning.
The FDA issued the warning because the company described the laser as performing skin resurfacing procedures, company spokesman Richard Dukas said.

ESC does not have specific FDA approval to market the laser as performing skin resurfacing. It is approved for "incision, excision, ablation, vaporization, and hemostasis of soft tissue," which Dukas said are procedures that achieve the same effect as skin resurfacing.
"This won't affect the business or how it's conducted in any way, shape or form," he said.
The company's stock was halted for a time by Nasdaq earlier Tuesday. It was down 2-1/2 to 24 shorty before closing. It had fallen as low as 22-3/4 following release of the news.
